sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, though they've won just one of their last two outings. Alsager are struggling near the foot of the division with only 4 points from 10 games and arrive as heavy underdogs.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a crucial away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, with both sides chasing the top spot and looking to apply pressure on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in an intriguing clash between third and fifth place, while Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community to a local derby at 15:00. Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town in a mid-table fixture, and Shawbury United face an uphill battle against high-flying Barnton. Market Drayton Town travel to face New Mills in a bottom-half encounter, while Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in what shapes as a fixture between two of the division's struggling sides. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-table clash, and Brereton Social welcome Widnes Town knowing that Widnes sit bottom with just 2 points and are in desperate form. Brereton also face a midweek fixture at home to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening.
